The Age of Gemini: How New Google Cloud Agents Will Transform Work

The video analyzes Gemini's ads at Work 2026: the passage from conversational AI to agents performing tasks. It shows the agent's reasoning cycle, the isolated sandbox, the identity and gateway for security, the cost controls, the agent's memory at work, and cases such as Sompo insurance and a NASA satellite.

Published in 10 October 2026 · 7 min 56 s

  • Agentic engineering
  • Cloud and reliability

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

From conversation to execution

The video deals with the passage of the conversational AI, in chat format, to the autonomous and agency AI with Gemini 00:00. The AI ceases to be an oracle that answers questions and becomes an execution engine 00:20.

According to the video, from October 2026 the AI ceases to be only a text tool and starts to act as a workforce, performing complex tasks on behalf of those who manage it 00:20.

The Ascent of Agents

In the traditional model, it was necessary to give commands all the time, with prompt engineering. With agentic AI, a broad objective is delegated and autonomous reasoning takes care of the stages 01:04.

A Gemini agent is not a loose language model: it is an integrated system that plans, uses external tools, connects to company systems and delivers a ready product 01:24. It is the transition from passive assistance to proactive action 01:46.

The birth base

Gemini's managed agent works inside a sandbox. With an API call, the system creates an isolated Linux environment at the operating system level, where the agent writes and tests code, browses the internet and manages files 01:46. According to the video, it runs on models like Gemini Flash. 02:06.

Also according to the video, there is freedom of framework: LangGraph for complex streams, CrewAI for collaborating agents and LlamaIndex for connecting AI to internal data 02:27.

Whatever the framework, the agent runs on a continuous cycle 02:49:

1. Understands the request 02:49. 2. Set up a plan and choose the tools 02:49. 3. Act on your own 03:094. 4. Synthesizes the answer 03:09.

According to the video, a complex task can consume from 100,000 to 3 million tokens 03:09.

Safety and cost in scale

In companies, the platform needs to answer: who is the agent, what he can touch and where his actions are registered 03:31. Each agent receives a unique and encrypted identity, with the lowest possible privilege, and all traffic passes through an Agent Gateway, a firewall made for AI networks 03:31.

In hardware, the TPU 8i system delivers a price-to-performance ratio 80% better than the previous generation, which makes business loads dense viable 03:52.

Continuous loops on a large model would wipe out any budget 04:14. So there is intelligent routing, which sends each task to the right size model, and real-time spending limits. Price per token has fallen 98% since 2024 04:35.

The AI as a co-worker

The paradigm shift is to treat AI as a digital coworker: you can mention an agent in corporate chat or put him in a meeting invitation, and he acts with a defined identity, along with the team 04:56.

The integrated agent uses four types of memory. It retains the context of the company, remembers how to do recurring tasks and understands the history of the workflow, without having to reexplain the rules 05:16.

The golden rule is to ensure confidence in the accuracy of each response. Tools like the knowledge catalog map business definitions, so the agent responds anchored in real data instead of guessing internal terms 05:39.

The Real Impact

The video cites uses in telephone operators, banks and retail: agents who solve network failures in real time and detect fraud to cancel suspicious payments. This frees people for creative and advisory work 05:59.

Japanese insurance company Sompo has created over 10,000 custom agents for its 34,000 employees 06:41. According to the video, the development time of a specialized model dropped from a week to a day 06:41.

The agentic AI has also reached space: optimized models run on a NASA satellite, analyze images of the Earth and send summaries to ground teams 07:02.

The final reflection: the age of agency is not only accelerating tasks, but rethinking what an organization can accomplish when performing on a scale is no longer the problem 07:24.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Gemini isolate an agent's work?

In a sandbox: an isolated Linux environment at the operating system level, created by an API call, where the agent writes code, browses and manages files 01:46.

How does the platform control the cost of agents?

With smart routing, which sends each task to the right size model, and spending limits in real time 04:14.

About the video

** The work now begins in the prompt window!** In this explanatory video, we analyzed in detail the release of Gemini Agent** at the *Gemini at Work 2026* event, showing how Google Cloud is leading the transition to the era of corporate autonomous agents**.

Understand the evolution of Vertex AI to the **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform**, a unified infrastructure developed to build, scale, govern, and optimize agents capable of performing complex tasks with complete enterprise security and control.

---

**What you will learn in this video:**

• ** The New Gemini Agent:** How the universal working agent works that plans, executes code, manages files and connects systems from a single prompt.
* Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform:** The evolution of Vertex AI bringing the **Agent Studio** (low-code canvas), the **Agent Development Kit (ADK)** and the **RAG Engine** to connect private corporate data.
• **Persistent Memory and Orchestration:** The role of **Memory Bank** and **Agent Runtime** to maintain long-term context in multiple-day workflows.
• **Governance and Rigorous Safety:** As the **Agent Sandbox** isolated at OS level and the **Agent Gateway** ensure access control, audit and firewall against data leak.
• **Integer on Google Workspace:** The Gemini acts in a form *inline* in Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides, including as a co-worker agent.
• ** Financial Cost Control:** The optimization of budgets with **Smart Routing** and ceiling of real-time spending (*spend caps*).
